kitDescription: Laplace: Ultimate Hero is a charge rocket-launcher attacker whose attack stat scales off her own Max HP from battle start. Every full-charge shot builds a Warm Up stack, and at five stacks she swaps to a special 120-round piercing weapon ('Electric Power, Fully Full Charge') that fires until the rounds run out, then dumps her remaining ammo. While wielding the swap weapon, every 12 shots fill an Over Energy meter; each full meter permanently advances her Over Energy stage, stacking Max HP buffs that feed back into her HP-to-ATK conversion. Whenever anyone on the team enters Burst Stage 3 she gains a large Attack Damage buff, and her own burst grants her a big ATK buff, hits all enemies for a massive nuke, and — once she has at least one Over Energy stage — adds a bonus hit to the nearest enemy that grows linearly with her stage.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHAs: every divergence between the driver and the blind agents is either documented in the override's unmodeled/caveats fields or a blind-side test artifact. The load-bearing damage core (atkOfMaxHpPct HP→ATK passive; stageEnter:3 52.14% Attack Damage; burstCast 63.36% ATK; FB-exempt 2953.84% nuke; uses-based 9.45%×120 swap with swap-scoped Pierce; the 4-gate oeStage-scaled 934.76% rider) was independently derived by all three blind roles and the driver, and each line has a discriminating counterfactual that actually fails under its nearest-wrong model. The four unmodeled residuals are honest DOCUMENTED_GAPs with correct reasons: Warm Up (no stack-consume primitive — S6's modeled alternative is itself a flagged over-credit), the swap-end ammo dump (no swap-end trigger; S6 independently agreed, and the driver's inert-under-shared-mag reasoning is consistent), the 0–100% meter (folded into the kit-exact 240-count), and the stage Max HP buffs (quantified low-single-digit % under-credit). The one binding caveat for the owner: the swap weapon's fire cadence is kit-silent and the two estimates diverge 5× (driver 4 rounds/s vs S6 ~20 rounds/s) — this is the dominant unmeasured lever on her board number and also paces Over Energy stage unlocks, so the ⚑ measurement recipe (focus-video fire-rate read of Electric Power) should be run before her number is trusted; the same-model residuals to spot-check are the shared 'stageEnter:3 fires on any stage-3 caster' read, the shared-magazine inertness assumption behind the dropped ammo dump, and the counting-not-gated hitCount leak that unlocks stages slightly early.
